title: Environmental Sensor Dataset for LSTM-Based Predictive Irrigation in Smart Home Gardening Using Edge IoT
changes: Original workbook preserved. Sheet1 exported to CSV with original column names. Preprocessing is performed in ml/data.py without changing raw files.
